name: Setup deals 4 keywords to each seat and removes 8 words from the 120-word list
rule_text: At setup, each team is dealt 4 different keywords from a list of 120 nouns; no word goes to both teams, and a team's keywords are visible only to its two members.

name: All four token counts, standings and round number start at 0
rule_text: All four token counts (a_interceptions, a_miscommunications, b_interceptions, b_miscommunications) start at 0 and are public.

name: Team A encrypts in round 1 and Team B in round 2: invalid clues give each team one Miscommunication, and the game continues
rule_text: When round_number is odd in an odd pair, or even in an even pair, Team A encrypts; otherwise Team B encrypts.

name: Round 4 (even pair, Team A encrypts): Decoder seat 1 and Interceptor seat 3 guess; seats 2 and 4 are not asked
rule_text: In odd pairs (rounds 1-2, 5-6, 9-10, 13-14), seats 1 and 3 are Encryptors and seats 2 and 4 are Guessers; in even pairs, seats 2 and 4 are Encryptors and seats 1 and 3 are Guessers.

name: Round 5 (odd pair, Team A encrypts): Decoder seat 2 and Interceptor seat 4 guess; seats 1 and 3 are not asked
rule_text: In odd pairs (rounds 1-2, 5-6, 9-10, 13-14), seats 1 and 3 are Encryptors and seats 2 and 4 are Guessers; in even pairs, seats 2 and 4 are Encryptors and seats 1 and 3 are Guessers.

name: Round 3: Decoder seat 3 and Interceptor seat 1 are asked to guess; Encryptor seat 4 and seat 2 are not
rule_text: The Decoder is the encrypting team's Guesser, and the Interceptor is the other team's Guesser, so round 3 is Encryptor seat 4, Decoder seat 3, Interceptor seat 1.

name: Round 1 with valid clues: only Decoder seat 2 guesses, there is no Interceptor and no team gains an Interception
rule_text: In rounds 1 and 2, interceptor_seat is 0, no interception guess is asked, and the engine announces that there is no interception.

name: Guess options are the 24 ordered codes of distinct digits 1-4 (the code drawn is chance, so only the option set is checked)
rule_text: Each round, the code is drawn uniformly from the 24 ordered sequences of three different digits from 1 to 4 and is shown only to the Encryptor.

name: The Encryptor (seat 1 in round 1) writes the clues and is not asked to guess
rule_text: The Encryptor submits three clues in code order, each at most 3 words.

name: Invalid clue set in round 3 (Team B encrypts): B gains 1 Miscommunication, nobody guesses, no Interception and no history
rule_text: When the referee rules the clue set invalid, the code is revealed to everyone, the encrypting team gains 1 Miscommunication, no clues are added to the history and no guesses are taken.

name: Valid clue set: the guess step is reached and the Decoder is asked
rule_text: When the clue set is valid, the clues are shown to all players before the guesses.

name: Round 3 valid clues: both Decoder seat 3 and Interceptor seat 1 are polled in the same round
rule_text: The Decoder and the Interceptor submit their guesses at the same time, and neither sees the other's guess until both are in.

name: The Decoder's guess only affects the encrypting team's Miscommunications (whether it is right is chance): round 1 Team A encrypts, B's counts stay 0
rule_text: When the Decoder's guess differs from the true code in any digit, the encrypting team gains 1 Miscommunication.

name: An Interception only credits the Interceptor's team (whether it hits is chance): round 3 Team B encrypts, B gains no Interception and A no Miscommunication
rule_text: When the Interceptor's guess equals the true code exactly, the Interceptor's team gains 1 Interception.

name: Valid clues in round 1 add three clues to Team A's history and none to Team B's
rule_text: When the clues are valid, each clue is appended to the encrypting team's public history under the keyword number it clued.

name: After odd round 3 play continues even though Team A holds 2 Interceptions; standings are not recomputed
rule_text: The game can end only after an even-numbered round; after an odd-numbered round play always continues.

name: Team A triggers with 2 Interceptions at the end of round 2 and wins
rule_text: A team triggers when it has 2 or more Interceptions or the other team has 2 or more Miscommunications.

name: Team B's second Miscommunication in round 2 makes Team A the only team to trigger: A wins
rule_text: When exactly one team triggers at the end of an even round, that team wins and the game ends.

name: Both teams trigger at round 2: A has the better Interceptions minus Miscommunications (-1 against -2) and wins
rule_text: When both teams trigger at the end of an even round, the team with the higher Interceptions minus Miscommunications wins, and equal values are a draw.

name: Both teams trigger at round 2 with equal Interceptions minus Miscommunications: all four share the win
rule_text: When both teams trigger at the end of an even round, the team with the higher Interceptions minus Miscommunications wins, and equal values are a draw.

name: No trigger by round 16: A (1-1=0) beats B (0-1=-1) on Interceptions minus Miscommunications
rule_text: When neither team has triggered by the end of round 16, the team with the higher Interceptions minus Miscommunications wins, and equal values are a draw.

name: No trigger by round 16 with equal values: all four share the win
rule_text: When neither team has triggered by the end of round 16, the team with the higher Interceptions minus Miscommunications wins, and equal values are a draw.

name: Both members of Team B share its win when Team A has 2 Miscommunications at the end of round 2 (Team B encrypts in round 2)
rule_text: Both members of a team share its result, and there is no talk phase.
